title: Halcyon Reach Cruises: Norovirus on MV Halcyon Dawn
summary: A mid-size Galveston cruise line, its 2,980-passenger ship and its simulated outbreak, medical-reporting and guest-communication plans, with an exercise generated from them: a norovirus outbreak on a seven-night western Caribbean voyage, the CDC report clocks, a death on board and the decision whether to board the next voyage after a 3.5-hour turnaround.
notice: EXERCISE MATERIAL — for training use. Halcyon Reach Cruises, MV Halcyon Dawn, their people, guests, counts and itinerary are simulated; the public sources consulted for realism are listed in reference/halcyon-reach-cruises/SOURCES.md. The CDC and the other agencies are real, and nothing here is a CDC product or advice.

scenarios.title: Same Count, Every Channel
scenarios.summary: A norovirus outbreak spreads through MV Halcyon Dawn on the last four days of a seven-night voyage back to Galveston; the ship must hit the 2 and 3 percent special reports and the 24-hour and 4-hour reports on time, keep guest, family and media counts identical, handle a death on board, and decide whether the next 2,980 guests can board after a 3.5-hour turnaround.
